info.name: Open Sauce Documentation
info.description:
Open Sauce REST API Documentation

This collection is the single API reference for the Open Sauce backend. It contains the request format, authentication requirements, query/path parameters, success responses, and error examples for every endpoint.

Authentication uses Laravel Sanctum bearer tokens. Register and Login return a token; protected endpoints use Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}.

The examples are written for Postman documentation and are intended to be used by the Flutter team as the API contract.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints for registration, login, and logout.

request.description:
Create a new user account.

Request body contains only client-provided registration fields. The server generates user_id and the Sanctum token.

Success: 201 Created.

response.name: 422 Validation

request.description:
Authenticate an existing user using email and password.

On success, the response contains the authenticated user and a Sanctum bearer token. Postman stores the token automatically in {{authToken}}.

Success: 200 OK.

response.name: 422 Validation

request.description:
Revoke the current Sanctum token.

Send the token through Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}.

Success: 204 No Content.

item.name: For You

request.description:
Return the authenticated user's paginated For You feed.

Query parameters: page and per_page. The authenticated user's like/favorite state is returned with feed items.

Success: 200 OK.
Like a receipt. The authenticated user is taken from the Sanctum token; do not send user_id.
Remove the authenticated user's like from a receipt.
Return paginated comments for the selected receipt. Use receipt_id as a query parameter.

Create a new receipt/post.

The client sends receipt content and ingredient data. receipt_id, user_id, and timestamp are generated by the server.

response.name: 422 Validation

item.name: Favorites

request.description: Return paginated favorites belonging to the authenticated user.
Add a receipt to the authenticated user's favorites. Do not send user_id.
Remove a receipt from the authenticated user's favorites.

item.description: Endpoints for managing the authenticated user's favorite receipts.

item.name: Suggestions

request.description: Return paginated suggestions, optionally filtered by receipt_id.

Create a suggestion for a receipt.

The authenticated user is taken from the bearer token. Suggestion id, user_id, timestamp, and approval state are generated by the server.

response.name: 422 Validation

request.description: Like a suggestion as the authenticated user.
Remove the authenticated user's like from a suggestion.

Approve a suggestion belonging to the target receipt.

Only the owner of the target receipt is allowed to approve its suggestions.

response.name: 403 Forbidden

item.description: Endpoints for creating, viewing, liking, unliking, and approving suggestions.
